BiblicalUsage: The pa'amon is the small golden bell sewn around the hem of the high priest's robe, alternating with pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet. Its sound was heard as Aaron went in and out of the holy place before the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the bells remind me worship is heard as well as seen: the priest's coming and going before God was never silent, and neither is mine.
